title: Required-check workflows do not emit on merge_group
evidence: renovate.json:63-66 enables automerge; ci.yml:68, security-analysis.yml:58, reuse.yml:30, pr-validation.yml:199 trigger only on pull_request/push; git-workflow.md CI-040 requires merge_group
recommendation: Add a merge_group trigger to the on: block of all four required-check workflows before enabling the merge queue.

title: README Quick Start omits submodule init and setup.sh
evidence: README.md:80-92 Quick Start omits --recurse-submodules and ./setup.sh; correct sequence only at README.md:283-284 and docs/getting-started/install.md:29-48; checkout shows 14 dangling .claude/agents/ symlinks
recommendation: Add --recurse-submodules (or submodule update --init) and ./setup.sh to the Quick Start block.

title: The gh API client is re-implemented six-plus times
evidence: gh client duplicated at check-repo-compliance.py:141/159, check-required-checks.py:629, setup_org_rulesets.py:171/209, setup_repo_rulesets.py:34/89, sync_org_pins.py:65, populate-github-repos.py:75; check_quality_gate.py:31-45 uses urllib instead
recommendation: Extract one gh_api_common.py (mirroring compliance_log_common.py) and migrate every call site.

title: Skills spawn agents, violating the repo Command->Agent->Skill rule
evidence: supervisor.md:131 and ADR-004 state skills do not invoke agents; test-coverage/SKILL.md:54 and pr-review/workflows/pr-review.md:691 both spawn subagents
recommendation: Refactor the two skills to output-only, or amend ADR-004 and supervisor.md so the rule and code agree.

title: Coverage gate measures only src/, leaving ~7700 LOC of scripts ungated
evidence: pyproject.toml:484 source=[src], :494 omits scripts/*; src/ is 132 LOC vs scripts/ 6490 LOC; --cov-fail-under=80 certifies only 132 lines
recommendation: Add scripts/ and tools/ to coverage source, re-baseline, and enforce the 80% gate on the existing script tests.

title: No merge-queue rule declared despite automerge config
evidence: No merge_queue rule in any ruleset or setup_repo_rulesets.py; git-workflow.md CI-062 requires it once automerge is enabled
recommendation: Add a merge_queue rule (SQUASH, max_entries_to_build 5, min_entries_to_merge 1, wait 5min) to the main-branch ruleset.

title: 83 root-absolute links in AGENTS-AND-SKILLS.md 404 on GitHub
evidence: AGENTS-AND-SKILLS.md uses 83 root-absolute links that 404 on GitHub and break in MkDocs; README and CLAUDE.md have 0
recommendation: Rewrite the 83 links as repo-relative paths and add a link-check to CI.

title: MkDocs strict build has 85-plus pages not in nav and not excluded
evidence: docs.yml:57 runs mkdocs build --strict; ~85+ docs (docs/superpowers/ 44, docs/development/ 14, others) are neither in nav nor exclude_docs
recommendation: Add orphaned pages to nav or exclude_docs; confirm current docs.yml run status first.

title: Inverted package boundary: real logic lives outside the only package
evidence: pyproject.toml:137 packages=[src/claude_config] (132 LOC, imported by nothing); 6490 LOC in scripts/ unpackaged, reached via pyproject.toml:457 pythonpath + sys.path.insert in compliance_log_append.py:36, compliance_rollup_reconcile.py:26, compliance_log_render.py:19
recommendation: Promote script logic into src/claude_config submodules with console-script entry points so it is importable, testable, and coverage-measurable.

title: Committed HTML session reports expose personal filesystem data
evidence: Both files tracked in git; session-report-20260521-2204.html has 111 occurrences of /home/byron, the string byron@dadslaptop, and verbatim Claude session text; line 292 of the first embeds root: /home/byron/.claude/projects and 224 session records
recommendation: git rm --cached session-report-*.html, add session-report-*.html to .gitignore, document the policy in SECURITY.md.

title: Two session-report HTML files committed at repo root
evidence: 464KB combined, committed dd2bdcd; git check-ignore exit 1 (not ignored); .gitignore lacks a root session-report rule
recommendation: Add session-report-*.html to .gitignore and git rm --cached both; confirm no live credential with the security domain first.

title: sys.path.insert bootstrapping hacks across compliance scripts
evidence: sys.path.insert at compliance_log_append.py:36, compliance_rollup_reconcile.py:26, compliance_log_render.py:19; runtime symptom of the missing package boundary
recommendation: Delete these inserts after ARCH-01 packages the logic; they break under any CWD change.

title: ORGS constant duplicated as divergent literals
evidence: check-repo-compliance.py:34 ORGS list vs populate-github-repos.py:36 ORGS tuple; same data, divergent types
recommendation: Define ORGS once in a shared config module and import it.

title: ADR-008 missing from mkdocs.yml nav
evidence: ADR-008 exists on disk and in the ADR index but mkdocs nav stops at ADR-007
recommendation: Add ADR-008 to the mkdocs nav under the ADR section.

title: Submodule count and names drift in install docs
evidence: install.md:32 says five submodules; .gitmodules defines 7; README submodule names also mismatch
recommendation: Update install.md and README to list all 7 submodules by their actual .gitmodules names.

title: permissions.ask count claim is stale
evidence: settings-and-permissions.md:40 claims 22 permissions.ask entries; settings.json has 30
recommendation: Update the claim to 30 or replace the hard number with a generated count.

title: Three local agents undocumented; doc-audit agent count off by one
evidence: cleanup-backlog-scout, compliance-synthesis, ossf-criteria-reference missing from the catalog; doc-audit.py counts .claude/agents/CLAUDE.md as an agent
recommendation: Add the three agents to the catalog and exclude CLAUDE.md from the agent count in doc-audit.py.

title: Two YAML libraries in use across the same code layer
evidence: PyYAML imported in 2 files, ruamel.yaml in 3, across scripts/ and tools/; two parsers with different semantics for one job
recommendation: Standardize on one YAML library and document the choice in a rule.

title: release.yml missing top-level permissions deny-all
evidence: No top-level permissions block in release.yml; job-level permissions at line 65 are correct but future jobs inherit platform defaults; all 21 other workflows use top-level permissions
recommendation: Add permissions: {} at the workflow level between the concurrency block and jobs:.

title: Bare except Exception swallows YAML parse failures in validate_front_matter.py
evidence: validate_front_matter.py:92 and :177 catch bare Exception and return None/False silently, hiding parse and permission errors
recommendation: Replace except Exception with typed catches, log to stderr, and return a distinct sentinel so callers can warn.

title: Five tests assert only by absence of a raised exception
evidence: test_setup_org_rulesets.py lines 34,46,51,211,227 use validate_solo_dev_safe(body) with no explicit assert
recommendation: Add an explicit assertion to make the success condition visible.

title: setup-python steps without dependency caching
evidence: sync-org-pins.yml:49 fully uncached; pr-validation.yml:63 and codeql.yml:60 omit cache: but have adjacent cached setup-uv
recommendation: Add cache: to sync-org-pins.yml:49; the other two are low priority.

title: .mutmut_config is a stub while mutation CI runs
evidence: .mutmut_config is a NOT CONFIGURED cookiecutter stub; mutation-testing.yml:37 invokes the reusable python-mutation.yml weekly
recommendation: Remove the stub or populate it so local config matches the running CI.

title: Eight .disabled MCP config files retained as dead toggles
evidence: 8 files, 32KB; no loader references them; 7 under mcp/disabled/ undocumented, only zen-server documented in mcp/README.md:17,73
recommendation: Document mcp/disabled/ in mcp/README.md or delete the seven undocumented files.

title: Python 3.10 floor reaches EOL in five months
evidence: pyproject.toml requires-python >=3.10,<3.15, target-version py310; CPython 3.10 EOL 2026-10
recommendation: Bump floor to >=3.11 in Q4 2026 after 3.10 EOL; CI matrix already covers 3.11-3.14.

title: Renovate dev-dependency grouping rule never matches
evidence: renovate.json matchDepTypes [tool.uv.dev-dependencies] but dev deps live under [project.optional-dependencies].dev
recommendation: Correct matchDepTypes to the PEP 621 optional-dependencies dep-type so dev bumps group into one PR.

title: Near-duplicate gh subprocess wrappers across compliance scripts
evidence: check-repo-compliance.py:141/159 vs check-required-checks.py:629 reimplement the same gh run+JSON+error-tuple logic
recommendation: Extract a gh_api_common.py helper and route both scripts through it.

title: 61 production Any annotations at decode boundaries
evidence: 61 production Any (105 total): check-required-checks.py 18, populate-github-repos.py 14, compliance_log_common.py 7
recommendation: Replace Any with TypedDict where parsed shapes are fixed; keep Any only at dynamic edges.

title: Submodule pin freshness unverifiable in this tree
evidence: .gitmodules declares 7 submodules, all uninitialized in this tree; 3 are third-party upstreams
recommendation: Init submodules and compare pinned SHAs to upstream HEAD; flag any third-party module with no commit in 12+ months.

title: CHANGELOG format is inconsistent
evidence: 3645-line CHANGELOG with no Keep-a-Changelog header, mixed manual/semantic-release format, HTML-escaped arrows
recommendation: Add the Keep-a-Changelog header and let python-semantic-release own the format; stop hand-editing released sections.
